en: A black‑and‑white view over a very crowded open‑air market in a European city square. Numerous stalls and umbrellas fill the foreground, with many people in early‑20th‑century clothing. Behind the market stand several multi‑storey stone and brick buildings, and in the background are tall church spires and a large historic town‑hall‑like building. A tramway or road with pedestrians and carriages runs between the market and the buildings.
